title: HR Administrator
company: Crossroads Truck & Bus Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Are you an organised and proactive HR administrator looking for your next opportunity? We're seeking a HR Administrator to join our team on a 6-month fixed-term contract, supporting a wide range of HR activities and helping to deliver an excellent employee experience.

Crossroads Truck & Bus Ltd is the Volvo Truck and Bus specialists across Yorkshire and Lincolnshire. We provide a total transport solution for the industry, from new trucks to used trucks, and parts and servicing for trucks, buses and trailers.

The Role

You'll provide day-to-day HR administrative support across the employee lifecycle, including:
- Providing administration support for the induction process.
- Maintaining employee records and HR systems.
- Supporting managers with HR processes.
- Providing first-line HR support to employees and line managers.
- Liaising with payroll on starters, leavers and employee changes.
- Benefits administration including pension & health care.
- Producing HR reports and management information.
- Supporting employee engagement activities such as long-service awards.
- Assisting with general HR administration and compliance processes.

About You

We're looking for someone who has:
- Ideally previous HR administration experience.
- Ideally experience using HR systems and maintaining accurate records.
- A good understanding of HR policies and procedures.
- Strong Microsoft Office skills.
- Excellent communication and organisational skills.
- High attention to detail and a professional, confidential approach.

Qualifications: Good GCSEs and/or A-Levels, or a relevant degree/equivalent qualification.

What Do We Offer?
- Loyalty bonus.
- In house training.
- Excellent contributory pension scheme.
- Rewards gateway platform available for scheme members.
- Access to Les Mills and House of Wellbeing classes through the GoJoe app.

Crossroads Truck and Bus prides ourselves on providing excellent levels of customer service first time every time. Our commitment to our staff, training and well-being is at the forefront of our business.

If you are interested in the role please apply on our website with your CV, alternatively you can email your CV to Beth quoting the reference number.

You can also follow us at Twitter/Facebook/LinkedIn or via our website

title: Temporary HR Administrator
company: Hays Specialist Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
About the Role

We are currently recruiting for an experienced HR Administrator to join a busy HR team on a temporary basis. This role is fully site-based in LS10.This is a hands-on administrative role where you'll support the day-to-day running of the HR function, helping to ensure a smooth and efficient service for employees and managers.

Key duties will include:
- Managing and responding to queries in the HR inbox
- Supporting HR administration processes across the employee life cycle
- Maintaining accurate employee records and documentation
- Assisting with absence management administration
- Providing support to HR Advisors and the wider HR team
- Ensuring HR procedures are followed correctly and consistently
- Updating spreadsheets and producing reports using Excel

About You

To be successful in this role, you'll have:
- Previous experience in a HR Administration position
- Strong organisational and administrative skills
- Excellent attention to detail
- Good communication and customer service skills
- A proactive, can-do attitude
- Strong Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel
- The ability to work effectively as part of a team and manage multiple priorities

What's on Offer?
- Immediate start opportunity
- Competitive hourly rate
- Valuable experience within a busy HR environment
- Supportive and collaborative team
- Full-time hours for up to 16 weeks
- If you're an organised HR Administrator who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment, we'd love to hear from you.

Hays Specialist Recruitment Limited acts as an employment agency for permanent recruitment and employment business for the supply of temporary workers. By applying for this job you accept the T&C's, Privacy Policy and Disclaimers which can be found at hays.co.uk
